findings.problem: sanitizeMetadata (apps/api/src/services/audit.ts) also drops any key matching /password|token|secret|mfa|qr/i in addition to dropping arrays/objects. The chosen field names affectedDependents/affectedDependentsCount are safe, but the design never names this secret-key filter, so a future rename containing one of those substrings would silently lose the audit field again.
findings.fix: Add one sentence to §4 noting the scalar field names must also avoid the password|token|secret|mfa|qr substrings; rely on the §9.2 persisted-row assertion as the regression guard.

findings.problem: activate()/suspend()/entitle()/revoke() are described in prose but have no signatures or typed result shape, unlike requireModuleActive (full body) and the audit serialization (concrete snippet). The route-layer 404/409 mapping depends on an unstated return contract (union vs throw vs {ok,...}).
findings.fix: Add the four service signatures and an ActivateResult-style discriminated-union result type to §3 so the §6.2 handlers have an unambiguous contract to map to 404/409.

findings.problem: A nullable settings Json column is added and named as the future required-config seam, but the Phase-0 activate/suspend endpoints do not state whether they accept, ignore, or reject a settings body. POST /activate with a settings payload has no defined behavior.
findings.fix: State in §6.2 that Phase-0 activate/suspend take no body (or ignore settings), and that settings is written only by a future config step, so there is no half-wired write path.
